Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ১) The difference between the length and breadth of a rectangle is 23 m. If its perimeter is 206 m, then its area is ____ metre square.
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
We have: (l - b) = 23 and 2(l + b) = 206 or (l + b) = 103
Solving the two equations, we get:
l = 63 and b = 40
∴ Area = (l x b) = (63 x 40) m2 = 2520 m2

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ৩) In a shower, 5 cm of rain falls. The volume of water that falls on 1.5 hectares of ground is:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
1 hectare = 10,000 m2
So, Area = (1.5 x 10000) m2 = 15000 m2.
Depth =5/100 m=1/20m.
Volume = (Area x Depth) =15000 x1/20m3= 750 m3.

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ৪) What will be the cost of gardening 1 meter boundary around a rectangular plot having perimeter of 340 meters at the rate of Tk. 10 per square meter?
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
In this question, we are having perimeter.
We know Perimeter = 2(l+b), right
So, 2(l+b) = 340
As we have to make 1 meter boundary around this,
so Area of boundary = ((l+2)+(b+2)-lb)
= 2(l+b)+4 = 340+4 = 344
So required cost will be = 344 × 10 = 3440

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ৬) A boat having a length 3 m and breadth 2 m is floating on a lake. The boat sinks by 1 cm when a man gets on it. The mass of the man is:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Volume of water displaced= (3 x 2 x 0.01) m3
= 0.06 m3.
Mass of man= Volume of water displaced x Density of water
= (0.06 x 1000) kg
= 60 kg.

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ৭) A metallic sheet is of rectangular shape with dimensions 48 m x 36 m. From each of its corners, a square is cut off so as to make an open box. If the length of the square is 8 m, the volume of the box (in m cube) is:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
l = (48 - 16)m = 32 m, [because 8+8 = 16]
b = (36 -16)m = 20 m,
h = 8 m.
Volume of the box = (32 x 20 x 8) m cube
= 5120 m cube.

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ৮) The difference of the areas of two squares drawn on two line segments in 32 sq. cm. Find the length of the greater line segment if one is longer than the other by 2 cm.
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Let the lengths of the line segments be x and x+2 cm
then,
(x+2)2−x2=32
x2+4x+4−x2=32
4x=28
x=7cm

Hence, the greater line should be, x + 2 = 9

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ৯) The surface area of a sphere is same as the curved surface area of a right circular cylinder whose height and diameter are 12 cm each. The radius of the sphere is:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Curved surface area of sphere =(4/π)r2
Surface area of cylinder =2πrh
=>(4/π)r2=2πrh
=>r2= (6×12)/2
=>r2= 36
=>r= 6

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ১০) 50 men took a dip in a water tank 40 m long and 20 m broad on a religious day. If the average displacement of water by a man is 4 m³, then the rise in the water level in the tank will be:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Total volume of water displaced = (4 x 50) m3 = 200 m3.
Rise in water level =200/(40 x 20)m 0.25 m = 25 cm.

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ১৪) What is the least number of squares tiles required to pave the floor of a room 15 m 17 cm long and 9 m 2 cm broad?

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ১৬) The ratio between the length and the breadth of a rectangular park is 3 : 2. If a man cycling along the boundary of the park at the speed of 12 km/hr completes one round in 8 minutes, then the area of the park (in sq. m) is:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Perimeter = Distance covered in 8 min. = (12000/60)x 8m = 1600 m.
Let length = 3x metres and breadth = 2x metres.
Then, 2(3x + 2x) = 1600 or x = 160.
Length = 480 m and Breadth = 320 m.
Area = (480 x 320) m2 = 153600 m2.

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ১৭) A rectangular park 60 m long and 40 m wide has two concrete crossroads running in the middle of the park and rest of the park has been used as a lawn. If the area of the lawn is 2109 sq. m, then what is the width of the road?
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Area of the park = (60 x 40) m2 = 2400 m2.
Area of the lawn = 2109 m2.
Area of the crossroads = (2400 - 2109) m2 = 291 m2.
Let the width of the road be x metres. Then,
60x + 40x - x2 = 291
x2 - 100x + 291 = 0
(x - 97)(x - 3) = 0
x = 3.

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ১৮) A rectangular field is to be fenced on three sides leaving a side of 20 feet uncovered. If the area of the field is 680 sq. feet, how many feet of fencing will be required?
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
We have: l = 20 ft and lb = 680 sq. ft.
So, b = 34 ft.
Length of fencing = (l + 2b) = (20 + 68) ft = 88 ft.

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ১৯) A tank is 25 m long, 12 m wide and 6 m deep. The cost of plastering its walls and bottom at 75 paise per sq. m, is
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Area to be plastered= [2(l + b) x h] + (l x b)
= {[2(25 + 12) x 6] + (25 x 12)} m2
= (444 + 300) m2
= 744 m2.
Cost of plastering = Rs.744 x (75/100)
= Rs. 558

Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.question: ২০) A metallic sheet is of rectangular shape with dimensions 48 m x 36 m. From each of its corners, a square is cut off so as to make an open box. If the length of the square is 8 m, the volume of the box (in m³) is:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
Clearly, l = (48 - 16)m = 32 m,

৩০) An error 2% in excess is made while measuring the side of a square. The percentage of error in the calculated area of the square is:
Area, Volumes & Surface Area, Height & D.exp:
100 cm is read as 102 cm.
A1 = (100 x 100) cm2 and A2 (102 x 102) cm2.
(A2 - A1) = [(102)2 - (100)2]
= (102 + 100) x (102 - 100)
= 404 cm2.
Percentage error =404/(100 x 100) x 100%= 4.04%
